description: The file defines the OnlineSessionProvider class, which manages WebSocket connections, message subscriptions, and match subscriptions for an online gaming session within a Flutter app. It handles connection states, error signaling, and interaction with a network repository, acting as a state management provider that notifies UI components of changes.

classes.name: OnlineSessionProvider
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages WebSocket connectivity, session state, and match subscriptions for an online game, providing methods to connect/disconnect, subscribe/unsubscribe to matches, and handle errors/messages.

methods.name: sessionState
methods.description: Provides access to the current online session state.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Indicates whether the provider is actively connecting or reconnecting.

methods.name: lastError
methods.description: Returns the last non-transient error message, used for display banners.

methods.name: lastToast
methods.description: Returns the last transient message, typically for snackbars.

methods.name: clearToast
methods.description: Clears the last transient toast message.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a WebSocket connection and subscribes to real-time messages and connection states, with automatic reconnection logic.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connections and stops subscriptions.

methods.name: subscribeToMatch
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific match by ID, handling potential circuit break errors.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromMatch
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the currently subscribed match.

methods.name: quickMatch
methods.description: Requests a quick match via REST API, returning the match ID if immediately available.

methods.name: loadLobbies
methods.description: Fetches a list of available lobbies with pagination.
